mainEntity.name: Can AI build my website and sales pages if I don’t know web development?

acceptedAnswer.text:
AI can help draft pages and technical instructions, but a website still needs a clear offer, usable structure, accurate information, working forms, tested links, and ongoing updates. Run My AI Biz includes website, directory, hosting, and search-related workflow examples.

A generated website may look complete while missing important customer paths or containing invented details. Review every page from a visitor’s perspective before sending traffic to it.

Key factors:
- The purpose of each page.
- Mobile display and accessibility basics.
- Forms, checkout, booking, and email delivery.
- Ownership of the domain, content, and connected accounts.

Use AI to create a sitemap, draft page content, and produce a testing checklist. Complete test submissions and purchases, confirm notifications, and correct unsupported claims before launch.

Run My AI Biz’s education can help organize the build without presenting generated pages as automatically ready.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can help plan pages, draft copy, and explain setup steps, but you must verify layout, forms, checkout, links, ownership, and claims. Test the full visitor and customer path before launch.
